customManagers.description: Versions of software the cookbooks install (attributes and resource property defaults): put `# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name>` on the line above; the value is the last single-quoted string on the next line (attribute keys are quoted too).

packageRules.description: release-please 只对 feat/fix/perf/revert 发版；cookbook 里的依赖升级用 fix(deps)，合并后进入发布 PR。
Bare version values (3.7.2); the recipes add the tag's `v` themselves, so strip it. Values that keep the v (k0s) are left alone.

Third-party versions the cookbooks install: one weekly PR, so a week of upstream releases becomes one patch release per cookbook (release.yml counts chore(deps) as patch). k0s pins a sha256 next to its version; nothing else needs a second edit.
prBodyNotes: k0s 旁边写死的 `sha256` 要在本 PR 里一起改。合并后进入发布 PR；节点要等 homelab-infra 的 policy 改 `= 版本` 并 `cinc update` 才会用上。

packageRules.description: HAProxy from haproxy.debian.net, pinned to the 3.4 LTS branch (the LB contract was verified against 3.4): patches within the branch only.
